notes.title: TERMINATION OF SERVICE NOTICE
notes.content:
[b]NOTICE of Service Termination of “SWORDS of GARGANTUA” for Meta Quest and PCVR
[/b]
Thank you for your continued support and patronage of “SWORDS of GARGANTUA”.
This announcement is to inform our users that the Meta Quest and PCVR service for 
“SWORDS of GARGANTUA” will discontinue its service [b]on September 30, 2022[/b].
After this date, you will no longer be able to play the game and use its online features.
The development team would like to [b]deeply thank everyone[/b] who has supported, enjoyed and helped us improve the game since its launch in 2019.

[h2]Service Termination Schedule[/h2]
[b]August 31st 2022[/b] : Meta, Steam store end of sales
[b]September 30th 2022[/b]: End of service

notes.title: New Login Bonus are on! Also Quality of Life improvements!
notes.content:
The second part of the welcoming event for new swordsmen is starting soon!

All weapons that appear in the adventure mode shop are on a special sale of 50% off, including the current event weapons Knight Sword, Light Sword and Kujo Ringo Shield! 

[Event period]
From Wednesday, December 23rd to Wednesday, January 12th 2022

[Weapons for sale]
2500 coins: Knight Sword LVL1, Light Sword - Blue
5000 coins: Knight Sword LVL2, Light Sword - Red
15000 coins: Knight Sword LVL3, Light Sword - Green, Kujo Ringo Shield
and more!

Please note
- Items purchased in the shop can be used only in the Adventure mode, single or multiplayer.
- The shop and the items on sale appearance is random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33507112/e45b0885e84140ee87c93e5089a9b38c68cd2905.png[/img]

The 3rd part of the welcome event for new swordsmen is here!

From December 23rd to January 8th, log in to Gargantua and receive one of 3 re-released event weapons and 30,000 bonus coins each day, EVERYDAY!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33507112/2f8a9e5d83803b1fc0c974cff86da90efb133783.png[/img]

And last but not least, quality of life improvements!

The previously "Multiplayer Festival" event was extremely popular among users, so we decided that it will be adopted as an official game specification [b]after December 23, 2021[/b]!
A small quality of life improvement that we hope will make you enjoy the game even further.

・ Added +6 and +7 stages to Warp Gate.
・ Reduced the probability of debuff route occurrence.
・ Eased the conditions for obtaining stage clear rewards.
・ Increased the appearance rate of event weapons Lv.2 ~ 3 with stage clear rewards.
・ Adjusted the amount of coins earned.
・ Adjusted of shop spawning rate.

* The above specifications are for Adventure Mode Multiplayer only. 
Not applicable to single player.
